These milestones reflect our belief that ETH should be managed as a productive operating asset rather than simply held for potential appreciation. Our permanent capital base enables us to pursue longer-duration treasury deployments and differentiated yield opportunities, while maintaining a disciplined approach to risk management. As Ethereum’s institutional adoption continues to accelerate, we believe Sharplink is well-positioned to leverage our scale, institutional expertise and ecosystem relationships to generate incremental ETH, grow ETH-per-share and create sustainable long-term value for shareholders.” 1 Third Quarter 2026 Highlights Income Statement and Balance Sheet ● Total revenue increased 24% to $13.5 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared with $10.8 million in the prior-year quarter. Staking revenue grew 27% to $13.1 million from $10.3 million, reflecting Sharplink’s ongoing ETH treasury management activities. ● SG&A expenses decreased 8% to $11.0 million, compared with $12.0 million in the prior-year quarter, as the Company continued to carefully manage the operating costs of its treasury platform. ● Net income increased to $751.4 million, or $3.45 per diluted share, compared with net income of $104.3 million, or $0.62 per diluted share, in the prior year quarter. The increase was driven principally by unrealized and realized gains on crypto assets.

Combined with its ongoing technological advancements, deep liquidity and commitment to security, we believe Ethereum is uniquely positioned to support the next generation of global financial activity. As institutional adoption accelerates and more economic activity moves onchain, Sharplink is well-positioned to participate in Ethereum’s continued growth through its actively managed ETH treasury and commitment to supporting the broader ecosystem.” Ethereum Treasury and Operational Highlights ● Sharplink’s ETH holdings totaled approximately 892,708 ETH 1 as of September 30, 2026, and 895,117 ETH 2 as of November 2, 2026. ● Crypto assets totaled approximately $2.1 billion as of September 30, 2026, valued in accordance with U.S. GAAP. 1 Total ETH holdings held as of September 30, 2026, comprised of 602,361 native ETH, 135,516 ETH as-if redeemed from LsETH, 73,334 ETH as-if redeemed from weETH, and 81,497 ETH as-if-redeemed from wstETH, using a conversion date of September 30, 2026. 2 Total ETH holdings held as of November 2, 2026, comprised of 603,953 native ETH, 135,868 ETH as-if redeemed from LsETH, 73,601 ETH as-if redeemed from weETH, and 81,695 ETH as-if-redeemed from wstETH, using a conversion date of November 2, 2026. 2 ● Completed the staking of $200 million of ETH through Lido on September 28, 2026, receiving wrapped staked ETH (wstETH) and expanding Sharplink’s liquid staking capabilities. The allocation is designed to generate protocol staking rewards while providing access to additional onchain opportunities. ● The Galaxy Sharplink Onchain Yield Fund (the “Fund”), launched in August 2026 with $125 million in initial commitments consisting of $100 million from Sharplink and $25 million from Galaxy Digital. The Fund began deploying capital into select onchain opportunities in Q3. ● Made a strategic equity investment in Blockspace, an Ethereum infrastructure company focused on validation and staking infrastructure.
